title: Publish new version with strict final release verification
rawUserRequest: Execute every Work Item in the dated plan serially without stopping; the user has authorized the final new-version publication and all required repository/provider actions.

declaredIntent.summary: Prepare and publish the next immutable AI Cockpit release v0.5.42 from the merged default-branch commit after Work Items 0 through 22 are closed, preserving fail-closed identity, asset, distribution, and evidence gates.

guidelines: Preserve immutable release identity and fail-closed publication gates.
Do not claim publication, public installation, or security assurance without provider-bound evidence.
Keep final release evidence and user-review status explicit and separate.

intent.problem: The completed serial plan requires one immutable new release whose source identity, release assets, supply-chain evidence, installer behavior, and public distribution are independently verifiable.
constraints: Prepare v0.5.42 from the freshly resolved merged default-branch commit.
Use the existing release workflow as the external evidence authority.
Do not move or rewrite existing tags; fail closed on any unknown, mismatch, missing human decision, or verifier error.
Retain explicit user-review and residual-risk boundaries after closure.
intent.rationale: A dedicated final Work Item can prepare candidate metadata through a PR, then invoke the existing exact-source provider workflow only after merge and verify the published artifacts before recording final evidence.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Published v0.5.42 and unpublished v0.5.43 candidate metadata are sequential and internally consistent.
The release workflow binds the exact merged default-branch SHA to tag, assets, CI, and provider evidence.
A failed or unknown release gate leaves immutable tag and publication state unchanged.
Post-publication public install and lifecycle checks consume the published immutable release evidence.
